skill.name: project-scaffolder
skill.description: Creates structured Markdown templates for self-learning resource projects, including plan.md, task.md, persona.md, project-context.md, and CLAUDE.md.
skill.summary: Scaffolds learning resource projects with planning, task, persona, context, and Claude instruction templates.
skill.author: BitYoungjae

security_audit.summary: All static findings appear to be false positives from Markdown backticks, placeholder syntax, and checklist language. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable command instructions in the reviewed files. The skill requests Bash access, but the documented workflow does not require shell execution.

remediation.issue: Bash is listed in allowed tools without a documented need.
remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash from allowed-tools, or document the exact safe command use that requires it.

content.value_statement: Planning a learning resource can leave teams with scattered outlines and inconsistent tasks. This skill creates coordinated Markdown templates for structure, tasks, personas, context, and Claude project guidance.
actual_capabilities: Generates a plan template with Part, Chapter, and Section hierarchy.
Creates a task checklist that mirrors the planned learning structure.
Provides persona guidance for writer identity and reader profile.
Captures target environment, references, versions, and research notes.
Builds CLAUDE.md instructions for writing sessions and quality checks.
limitations: It provides templates and guidance, not finished course content.
It depends on user-provided topic, audience, page count, and environment details.
It does not verify external references or software versions automatically.
Bash permission is declared but not needed for the documented workflow.

use_cases.title: Plan a Technical Guide
use_cases.description: Create a structured outline, task list, and project context before writing a long technical guide.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Self-Study Curriculum
use_cases.description: Define audience level, learning objectives, session boundaries, and page allocation for a new curriculum.

use_cases.title: Standardize AI Writing Projects
use_cases.description: Start Claude Code documentation projects with consistent files, instructions, and review criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Project Scaffold
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new learning resource.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-scaffolder for a 100 page beginner guide about {topic}. Create the planning files with clear placeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Define Audience and Environment
prompt_templates.scenario: Add reader and environment detail before writing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Scaffold a learning resource for {target audience} on {topic}. Include target system details, references, and persona guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build Session-Based Tasks
prompt_templates.scenario: Organize a long guide into Claude Code sessions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create plan.md and task.md for a {page count} page guide. Divide tasks into sessions of related sections.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Full Documentation Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced setup with quality and writing rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the full scaffold for {project title}. Include structure, tasks, personas, context, CLAUDE.md rules, and review criteria.

output_examples.input: A request to plan a 100 page beginner guide for a web development topic.
output_examples.output: A coordinated scaffold with planning, tasks, persona notes, project context, and Claude writing instructions.

output_examples.input: A documentation lead asks for session boundaries across a multi-part guide.
output_examples.output: A task list grouped by related sections, with page targets and completion criteria for each writing session.

output_examples.input: An educator needs a curriculum outline for intermediate learners.
output_examples.output: A structured plan with learning objectives, prerequisites, chapter topics, reader profile, and reference sections.

best_practices: Provide topic, audience level, target system, language, and expected page count before scaffolding.
Review page allocations before writing so chapters and sessions stay balanced.
Keep references current and replace placeholder values before starting content generation.
anti_patterns: Do not use the scaffold as final content without writing and review.
Do not leave placeholder variables in published project files.
Do not declare shell tool access unless the project workflow requires it.

faq.question: What files does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates templates for plan.md, task.md, persona.md, project-context.md, and CLAUDE.md.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude Code?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, but the templates include Claude-specific project guidance.

faq.question: Does it write the finished guide?
faq.answer: No. It creates the project scaffold that guides later writing sessions.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the topic, audience level, total pages, language, and target environment.

faq.question: Can it help with non-technical subjects?
faq.answer: Yes. The persona template includes guidance for technology, history, science, arts, and general domains.

faq.question: Does it need shell access?
faq.answer: The documented workflow does not require shell access. Removing Bash from allowed tools would reduce risk.
